subject: general
question: Karthik invested an amount of Rs.9,000 in a fixed deposit scheme for 3 years at compound interest at the rate of 2% p.a. How much amount (correct to two decimal places) will he get on maturity of the fixed deposit?
solution:
**Given:**

Investment amount = Rs. 9000

Time = 3 years

Rate of compound interest = 2%

**Formula used:**

Compound rate of interest for 3 years if Rate % is same for each year = 3R + 3R²/100 + R³/10000 

where R = Rate % for each year

Amount = Principal (1 + Rate/100)ⁿ

Where n = time period

**Calculation:**

Compound rate of interest for 3 years = (3 × 2) + (3 × 2²)/100 + 2³/10000

⇒ 6 + 0.12 + 0.0008</p
